videos.title: How to Self-Host on the Dark Web
videos.script_preview: You can host a secure site with zero public IP exposure, no registrar fees, and no SSL certificate authority. By running a local server as a Tor hidden service, your site is accessed via an address derived from its public key. To start, edit `/etc/tor/torrc` to define your dedicated hidden service path. The catch: this directory must not be your web root. Tor insists on owning this folder. Assign it to the `debian-tor` user and set `chmod 700` or Tor won't launch. videos.title: Build a Physical iOS Phone Farm at Home
videos.script_preview: You can now run automated TikTok posts on physical iPhones, controlled entirely from your web browser. An open-source tool called Handler turns spare iOS devices into a self-hosted local phone farm. The tasks are managed by a durable Docker-based Postgres queue, preserving your queue even through crashes.
